permit.applies: The employer applies for an expatriate quota under the Minister's Expatriate Quota Regulations; the Expatriate Quota Allocation Board reviews it and advises the Minister, who grants it.
permit.first: No Gambian with the knowledge, skills or expertise for the position; the employer must take on a Gambian understudy.

fees.what: Residential Permit B (to reside and work), non-ECOWAS national (the Alien Card, D2500, included)

permit.union: The Expatriate Quota Allocation Board that reviews every application includes one representative from the Trade Unions (Labour Act 2023, s. 31(q)).
permit.feesNote: An ECOWAS national pays D3,600. The page reads 'D7700 (D2500 for the Alien Card)' and says the card's cost is included in the costs shown.

sources.title: FAOLEX (FAO), Labour Act 2023 of The Gambia; rests on the Labour Act 2023 (Gambia Gazette; no official text online found; the National Assembly's home page given)
sources.said: (q) one representative from the Trade Unions. … (a) review all applications for expatriate quota and advise the Minister; … (d) ensure that decisions are taken on applications within five working days from the date of receipt of an application and send its recommendation to the Minister for approval or otherwise within fourteen days; … an employer of an expatriate to whom an expatriate quota is granted by the Minister, shall employ a Gambian counterpart to understudy the holder of the expatriate position

sources.title: Gambia Immigration Department, Residential Permit (Common Crawl capture of 14 October 2026, CC-MAIN-2026-43)
sources.said: Resident Permit B This type of permit is issued to persons who intend, upon admission, to live, reside and work in the Gambia. … The prescribed fees, subjected to changes, for Residence Permit A/B, Alien Card and Non-Gambian ID Card are as follows: Residential Permit A (ECOWAS) = D3100 Residential Permit B (ECOWAS) = D3600 Residential Permit A (Non-ECOWAS) = D5700 (D2500 for the Alien Card) Residential Permit B (Non-ECOWAS) = D7700 (D2500 for the Alien Card)

sources.title: Labour Act, 2023 (National Assembly of The Gambia, Acts & Laws, document 16)
sources.said: (q) one representative from the Trade Unions. … 32. Functions of the Expatriate Quota Allocation Board (1) The Expatriate Quota Allocation Board shall notwithstanding section 9A of the Pay Roll Tax Act, - (a) review all applications for expatriate quota and advise the Minister; … (d) ensure that decisions are taken on applications within five working days from the date of receipt of an application and send its recommendation to the Minister for approval or otherwise within fourteen days; … 38. Training of Gambians by employers (1) Notwithstanding anything contained in the Immigration Act and the Pay Roll Act, an employer of an expatriate to whom an expatriate quota is granted by the Minister, shall employ a Gambian counterpart to understudy the holder of the expatriate position
